name: ClearClef
description: Score catalog taken from the Red Dead Redemption menus. Type sits on a near-black ground. The folio holds the engraved score. Plates hold forms only.
rule: Three surfaces: ground for navigation and lists, folio for notation, plate for forms. Capitals are Bitter. Sentence case is EB Garamond. Geist Mono is for identifiers only. Gilt is the current item. Vermilion is the wordmark bar only.
valueStructure: dark ground with light type; paper only for the score; plates only for forms

from-references.vermilion: #d92b1e — the logo 'II' and the map routes/markers; state only
from-references.slate: #59616e — the map's region lettering; the cool counterpoint
from-references.bone: #f0ece4 — the logo's letterform white; text on hide

capitals.usage: catalog H1, page headings, detail title, wordmark (900), nav, buttons, labels, running heads, imprints
capitals.tracking: 0.005em at display sizes; 0.09-0.14em for label sizes — heavy and tight, never light and airy

sentence.usage: row titles, credit headings, body reading, extents, shelf marks, form labels

technical.usage: ids, byte sizes, page counters, admin metadata only

material.approach: The page is surface-ground: near-black, fine grain, vignette. The score is surface-folio. Forms are surface-board. See docs/design.md.
material.remap: on-board — remaps ink, body, muted, print, hairlines, field border, focus, gilt, rubric, semantics, placeholder, surface-strong and the page colour as a recessed well
material.seam: rule-tooled: hidden groove with a brass catch along the board edge
material.liveSeal: seal-live: rubric border plus the ONE vermilion dot
material.endpaper: retired — empty states are type on the ground
material.dead-ends: a 285px multiplied mottle (reads as camouflage) and an anisotropic 0.42/0.055 hide grain (reads as planks). Do not reintroduce either.
